quotes.text: How can we do a preemptive Federal privacy and data security law that specifically allows for those protections, while prohibiting the stifling of entrepreneurs or new market entrants into tech-related industries, quantum computing, social media, AI, et cetera?

And I know it was touched on earlier, talking about AI, NTIA being one of the many agencies seeking input on responsible policy regarding AI. And I wanted to know with this public policy request for comment period that you guys are in, what are some of the biggest challenges that you are going to be seeing or that you foresee as it relates to communications networks and AI?
